limitations: Mean and sample SD (ddof=1) describe variation across different prompts, not a confidence interval or repeated-run variance for one prompt.
Prefill includes the first output token; decode counts N-1 committed tokens, excluding rejected proposals. Loading and warmup are excluded.
Runs are sequential on one shared-memory Mac; power, frequencies and temperature are not controlled.
Original raw artifacts remain local. Original SHA-256 values identify source evidence, not hashes of sanitized derivatives.

Published sample counts and durations permit recomputation of rates and dispersion. Prompt text and full output IDs are omitted from results bundles; parity was checked directly on original integer-ID arrays.
Historical awake100/recheck5 cohorts are not the target-only baselines for the later MTP experiment.
Power differs: old Transformers spans battery to AC; other old100 runs use AC; all recheck5 runs use battery. This is not a controlled causal comparison of frameworks or power sources.
Cross-framework and repeat generated-output parity is not claimed here. Input prompt token IDs were checked for equality; output hashes are retained.
Transformers uses the project MLX-affine-to-Metal adapter; vLLM uses vllm-metal. MLX and MLX-VLM use wired memory; other backends retain their own policy.
